mapper.select: SELECT /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 프로그램 설명 : 표준영문약어명조회 -- 프로그램명 : -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */ '한글명' AS strnTermHanNm, '영문약어' AS strnTermEngcAbrNm, '영문명' AS strnTermEngNm, '화면표기명' AS strnTermScrnTermNm FROM DUAL WHERE '한글명' LIKE '%' || NVL(#{strnTermHanNm}, '') || '%'
